text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach. I'm brainstormin' bento
ideas for one
of my juniors.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be fun to have little rice ball
animals
surrounded by a forest made of
veggies?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You know, one of those cute character
bentos!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She could eat it in between training, and
she's not
exactly expectin' fine dining,
so I'm sure that'll
make 'er happy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if I recreated her favorite manga's
cover in
bento form, she'd love it! All
right, time to get
cookin'!
